description: MCP server that lets an AI assistant use the apps on your Windows PC by reading each window as text, through the accessibility tree.
notes: Add oriel to Claude Code with: claude mcp add --scope user oriel -- oriel mcp
Before 'scoop uninstall oriel', run this in PowerShell: & "$(scoop prefix oriel)\oriel.exe" uninstall
It stops oriel and deletes its settings folder, %LOCALAPPDATA%\oriel. Run the exe itself, not the 'oriel' shim: oriel uninstall stops every oriel process, and the shim ends the uninstall with it.
